tasks.short: Direct hearings so they stay fair and parties keep their rights.

steps.what: Monitor the activities of trials and hearings in the room
She will direct hearings to ensure they are conducted fairly
Judge whether courts administer justice while safeguarding the legal rights of involved parties

tasks.design: Nothing is built. She still monitors the hearing, directs it so it is conducted fairly, and judges whether the legal rights of the involved parties were safeguarded. There is no second record and no transport.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fairness in a live hearing is a judgement about the people in the room.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing in the digest changes the directing of a hearing.
tasks.still_hard: Safeguarding legal rights depends on what is said in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She sees whether a party was heard.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still directs the hearing.

reach.learn: Which rights warning she gives before testimony starts

evidence.claim: Directing a live hearing and judging whether it was fair stay with the officer in the room.
AI used by a judicial authority to apply law to facts is listed as high-risk.
The courts' note targets scheduling and pseudonymising, and says high-risk processes stay without a model for now.

assumptions: She monitors and directs the hearing herself today. No step is removed.
Spoken direction to the parties is not a versioned send, so it stays ungated.
No tool is introduced, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether a clerk, rather than she, keeps the hearing timetable.
research_questions: Which parts of directing the room does she never hand to a clerk?

already_counted.description: Watching the hearing, directing it, and the fairness judgement stay in the remaining time.

incremental.description: No tool is introduced, so upkeep is zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The hearing stays in the room, so the saving is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write the opinion and the decision after the hearing.

steps.what: Prepare written opinions from the facts and articles she lists {DOCS}
She decides the outcome those written decisions will state {DOCS}
Compose opinion paragraphs that restate only listed facts and articles {DOCS}

loop.input: The fact list and the article list from s1, and the outcome from s2.
loop.output: Paragraphs that restate only those facts and that outcome and cite only those articles.
loop.check: A sentence that states a fact absent from her fact list fails, a sentence that cites an article absent from her article list fails, and a sentence that states a different outcome from the one she decided fails.
loop.stop: One draft, or two failed checks, then she writes the paragraphs herself.
loop.why_not_simpler: The record is prose, so a fixed template cannot tell a fact she listed from a fact that was added.

steps.what: Reject a sentence whose fact or article is not on her list {DOCS}
Issue the written decisions she accepted to the parties {DOCS}

tasks.design: The work removed is composing the opinion paragraphs, which she does today after she has listed the facts and the articles and decided the outcome. Those paragraphs may restate only that list and that outcome. She still decides, she still rejects a sentence that adds a fact or an article, and she still issues the written decision. The issue is the same signature she gives today. The paragraphs stay a draft until she accepts them.
tasks.previous_blocker: The outcome is a judgement, and an unsigned model text was not a decision.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can restate facts and articles she has already listed, and the signature stays hers.
tasks.still_hard: Applying law to facts is high-risk, a wrong article is her responsibility, and she still signs every decision.
tasks.human_edge: She decides the outcome and she signs the decision.
tasks.altitude: She still decides and signs. The first paragraphs are a draft she can reject.

reach.task: Assemble the record an opinion will cite
reach.learn: Which facts she will allow a paragraph to restate

evidence.claim: A named legal workspace drafts text from legislation and case law.
A named arbitration tool produces a draft award that a human arbitrator reviews and authorises.
A published check found legal research tools giving wrong answers on a substantial share of queries.
The national bar says citations and case law are checked by hand and the lawyer stays responsible.
AI used by a judicial authority to apply law to facts is listed as high-risk.
A vendor that processes the case file needs a processor contract.
A decision based solely on automated processing is restricted.
Works-council consent can apply when a tool logs how a lawyer works.

assumptions: The 22 points are the paragraphs she writes today. Listing the facts, deciding the outcome, rejecting a bad sentence, and issuing the decision stay.

She produces the fact list and the article list in s1 before any paragraph is composed. Each entry is a fact she will allow or an article identifier she will allow. If a list is missing she writes the paragraphs herself.
The one focal hour keeps those field names current and is not inside the per-case listing. The clerk's sample hour is not her time.
Issuing the decision is the same signature she gives today, so it is not removed work. Nothing is filed a second time.
When she writes a short opinion herself the saving is zero. If a clerk writes the paragraphs, that time is not hers and the saving does not apply.
The draft does not decide and does not issue. She accepts the exact text in s4 before s5 sends it.
unknowns: Whether a clerk writes those paragraphs today.
Whether national rules for this body allow a draft of reasoning before the high-risk obligations start.
research_questions: Which opinions are short enough that she still writes every sentence?
Does a judicial law clerk write the first paragraphs on this body's files?

already_counted.description: Her fact list, her outcome, her rejection of a bad sentence, and her issue of the decision stay in the remaining time.

incremental.description: Keep the fact-field and article-field names current for the draft.
A judicial law clerk reads a sample of accepted paragraphs.

approvals.approved_version: the opinion text she accepted in s4, including any sentence she rewrote there

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When the opinion is short, or a clerk wrote it, she writes or edits every paragraph herself and the saving is zero. When the record is long, a failed check still sends some opinions back to her pen, so the high stays at 12, under the net after the one hour of field upkeep.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Hear and decide claims on eligibility, environment, and safety.

steps.what: Conduct hearings to review claims regarding those issues
She will decide social program eligibility and environmental protection from testimony
She states the enforcement of health and safety regulations she heard

tasks.design: Nothing is built. She still conducts the hearing, reviews the claim with the parties, and decides eligibility, environmental protection, and enforcement of health and safety regulations from the testimony. The written decision is a separate task. There is no second record and no transport.
tasks.previous_blocker: A claim is decided from what the parties say at the hearing.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing in the digest takes the hearing or the decision.
tasks.still_hard: Eligibility and enforcement depend on testimony she hears.
tasks.human_edge: She hears the claim and she decides it.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still hears the claim and decides it.

reach.learn: Which claims she still decides from testimony

evidence.claim: Hearing the parties and deciding the claim stay with the officer in the room.
AI used by a judicial authority to apply law to facts is listed as high-risk.
A decision based solely on automated processing is restricted.

assumptions: She conducts the hearing and decides the claim herself today. No step is removed.
The spoken hearing is not a versioned send, so it stays ungated.
No tool is introduced, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether a social-program file holds health data that needs a basis she does not control.
research_questions: Which claims does she decide only after live testimony?

already_counted.description: The hearing and both decisions stay in the remaining time.

incremental.description: No tool is introduced, so upkeep is zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The hearing and the decision stay with her, so the saving is zero.

tasks.short: Rule on motions and on whether evidence is admissible.

steps.what: Hear the exceptions and the motions as they are made
Rule on admissibility of evidence offered in the hearing
State that ruling to the parties in the room

tasks.design: Nothing is built. She still hears the exceptions and the motions, rules on admissibility of evidence, and states that ruling to the parties. There is no second record and no transport.
tasks.previous_blocker: Admissibility is a ruling on what was offered in the hearing.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing in the digest rules on a motion for her.
tasks.still_hard: The ruling depends on the objection she just heard.
tasks.human_edge: She rules on the evidence in the room.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still rules in the hearing.

reach.task: Hear an objection before a session
reach.learn: Which evidence she will not admit

evidence.claim: Ruling on a motion and on admissibility stays with the officer who heard it.
AI used by a judicial authority to apply law to facts is listed as high-risk.
The courts' note targets scheduling and pseudonymising, and says high-risk processes stay without a model for now.

assumptions: She hears the motion and rules on the evidence herself today. No step is removed.
Stating the ruling aloud is not a versioned send, so it stays ungated.
No tool is introduced, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether a clerk records the ruling after she speaks it.
research_questions: Which rulings does she make only after hearing the objection live?

already_counted.description: Hearing the motion, the admissibility ruling, and stating it stay in the remaining time.

incremental.description: No tool is introduced, so upkeep is zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The ruling stays in the hearing, so the saving is zero.

role.altitude: The hearing, the ruling, and the outcome stay hers. The week only loses the first opinion paragraphs, which she writes today. She still issues every decision.
reach: A judicial law clerk can assemble the fact list an opinion will cite, once she has said which facts a paragraph may restate.
An arbitrator can read a documents-only file before a hearing, once she has said which claims she still decides from testimony.
skills_to_grow: She lists the facts and the articles before any paragraph is composed.
She rejects a sentence that cites an article she did not list, and she still signs.
role.ambitious_version: She spends the morning on the outcome, and the first paragraphs are waiting when she sits down to sign.
